actual: expr: index.every(x => x.st === 'new-launch' || x.st === 'coming-soon') && index.some(x => x.st === 'coming-soon')

title: Index slugs match the site slug of every catalogue project
steps: Apply the site slug rule (NFKD, strip accents, lowercase, non-alphanumerics to hyphens) to each catalogue slug
Check that every index s value is in that set
expected: Every index item s value equals the site slug of a catalogue project, and the index is not empty.
actual: expr: (() => { const sl = s => s.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, ''); const set = new Set(projects.map(p => sl(p.slug))); return index.length > 0 && index.every(i => set.has(i.s)); })()
notes: Raw slugs such as talay-&-talay-... or lorévia-collection are cleaned by slugify in src/data/normalise.ts; the site slug is the one that must match.

probe.expr: (() => { const sl = s => s.normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-').replace(/^-+|-+$/g, ''); const set = new Set(projects.map(p => sl(p.slug))); return index.length > 0 && index.every(i => set.has(i.s)); })()

actual: expr: (() => { const ps = sitemap.filter(p => /^\/projects\/[^/]+$/.test(p)); return ps.length === projects.length && new Set(ps).size === ps.length; })()

probe.expr: (() => { const ps = sitemap.filter(p => /^\/projects\/[^/]+$/.test(p)); return ps.length === projects.length && new Set(ps).size === ps.length; })()
